fields.Awarded for: Contributions that have conferred the greatest benefit to humankind in the areas of Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, Economics.
fields.Country: Sweden (all prizes except the Peace Prize) Norway (Peace Prize only)
fields.Presented by: Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences (Physics, Chemistry and Economics [ 1 ] ) Nobel Assembly at the Karolinska Institute (Physiology or Medicine) Swedish Academy (Literature) Norwegian Nobel Committee (Peace)
fields.Rewards: A gold-plated green gold medal, a diploma, and a monetary award of 11 million SEK (approx. US$1.035 million as of 2023) [ 2 ] [ 3 ]
fields.Number of laureates: 627 prizes awarded to 1,012 individuals and organizations (as of 2024 [update] ) [ 2 ]
